english.title: Vaccinate domestic pig in England without authority of licence to do so or in accordance with Part 7
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) vaccinated a domestic pig in England against disease other than in accordance with Part 7 of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014 or under the authority of a licence granted by a veterinary inspector in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 28(1A) and 39(1A)(n) and (2) of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: From 29th April 2026, due to changes made by the Exotic Animal Disease (Amendment) (England) Order 2026 (SI 2026/475), this offence applies to domestic pigs in England. For the offence applying before this date, see H19860.
